notes: FIRSTHAND BUT UNSIZED ANECDOTAL RATE, not a measured P(hit) baseline. Keep this as a source-reported percentage of unclear scope, not a cast-count/hit-count study, not a 0-bin, and not eligible for current Retail gold EV. Similar copied multilingual Wowhead pages are the SAME original author, not independent cohorts.
